verdict.rationale: Notion's first-party docs say connections can subscribe to real-time events (page updates, property changes, new comments) via webhooks, with Notion sending a secure HTTP POST to a registered endpoint whenever a page or database changes. That is documented outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: details on event-type coverage, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
